prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a polished tangible 3D advertising scene for Sorted, a UK money-planning app. Square opaque image, dark slate studio cyclorama #0f172a. The concept is one phone gathering upcoming payment information from different bank accounts, NOT transferring money.
A silver-edged smartphone stands perfectly upright and front-facing at x=40% to 73%, y=12% to 86%, with parallel vertical sides. Blank dark slate screen #0f172a, no interface, tiny camera pill at the top. Do not cover its upper screen. Thick convincing aluminium edge, premium soft studio light.
Two sculptural strands of folded blank calendar/receipt paper travel from different sides into the phone. One starts at a small satin teal round bank pedestal on the LEFT at x=12%, y=55%, sweeping upwards behind where a card will be composited at x=4% to 40%, y=26% to 48%, and towards the phone's left edge. Another starts at a satin blue round bank pedestal on the RIGHT at x=88%, y=80%, sweeping up behind where another card will be placed at x=60% to 96%, y=58% to 80%, to the phone's right edge. The papers are blank, a few subtly embossed calendar squares only. The bank pedestals have simple architectural columns, NOT brand logos. Keep these two rectangular zones uncluttered for later compositing of real payment cards. Clearly legible layered depth, directional ribbons, balanced but asymmetrical composition. A few raised blank calendar leaves around the base echo the path to payday.
High-end stylised product render, tactile ceramic and folded paper, soft directional shadows, no neon, no purple glow, no coins or currency, no generic particle effects. No words, no letters, no numbers, no interface text, no watermarks. Main content safely inside image. Real app UI and transaction typography will be composited separately, so preserve clean empty screen and overlay zones.
note: Blank-screen scene. Real app components and campaign annotation composed separately in browser; no automated transfers.
